justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/StopWatch.java` (lines 125-222). `State` is a private nested enum with only 4 constants (`RUNNING`, `STOPPED`, `SUSPENDED`, `UNSTARTED`) and 3 abstract predicate methods (`isStarted()`, `isStopped()`, `isSuspended()`), each implemented per constant. It has a single responsibility: encoding stopwatch status checks used by `StopWatch`; it is very small and cohesive, with no evidence of excessive size, many methods, or multiple responsibilities.
